steps.title: Final test
steps.html:
Весь курс A0 — все восемь юнитов.

  • Задания из всех 24 уроков
  • Грамматика, лексика и порядок слов
  • Аудирование и чтение

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.html:
Omar

Hi! I'm Omar. I'm twenty-five.

My phone number is 07700 900 461.

I have two phones and three keys.

One phone is for work.

Hi! I'm Ray. It's Monday morning.

I'm tired and I'm cold.

My coffee is hot. Now I'm OK!

My sister is happy today — she isn't busy.

People ask me a lot of questions every day.

Where is the museum? When does it open? How much is a ticket?

My favourite question is: Why do you like your job? Because I meet people.
